picks.headline: Melofty Axom Max: an AI Rig Assistant builds guitar signal chains from a text or voice prompt
picks.excerpt: Melofty's Axom Max is a modeler/guitar synth whose AI Rig Assistant builds full pedal-amp-IR signal chains from a text or voice prompt like '80s British stadium rock', plus a DeepSynth pickup-free guitar synth.
picks.rationale: Most actionable item: new hardware where a prompt builds the whole pedal-amp-IR chain. That changes how a guitarist dials in tone, and no published card covers it.

picks.headline: Spotify becomes the first streaming service inside Meta's Muse AI agent
picks.excerpt: Spotify is the first streaming service connected to Meta's Muse AI agent: listeners can ask Muse to play audio, save songs and build Spotify playlists conversationally.
picks.rationale: New agent integration for listening and discovery. It is a separate story from the 9/26 Spotify Taste Profile card: a different feature and a different partner.

picks.headline: San Jose Sharks drop their goal song after fans find it was made with Suno
picks.excerpt: The San Jose Sharks replaced their goal song after only a season when fans discovered it had been generated with Suno.
picks.rationale: A concrete example of fan backlash against AI-generated music in pro sports. It is a fresh event, not related to the Suno lawsuit story.

picks.headline: Sony Music becomes the first music company in the ARIAM responsible-AI coalition
picks.excerpt: Sony Music Group becomes the first music company to join ARIAM, the Alliance for Responsible Innovation in the Arts & Media, alongside Disney, the BBC and The New York Times.
picks.rationale: An industry standard-setting move on responsible AI, not government politics. A major label is entering a cross-media AI coalition for the first time, and no published card covers it.

picks.headline: Fred again.. speaks out against AI music: 'the process is the magic'
picks.excerpt: Fred again.. spoke out against AI-generated music in a series of Instagram stories, arguing 'the process is the magic' of making music.
picks.rationale: A leading electronic artist's stance on AI and the creative process. It is a different artist and argument from the 9/22 Brian May card, and it adds a fifth distinct outlet.
